Executed in this revision. Exact Fraction certificates check all nine optima, barrier policies, supporting-line inequalities and infinite tails. Independent interval Bellman checks use horizon 96. Conditional-minimax and three-label LP diagnostics use floating point; they are explicitly distinguished from the rational certificates.

new_result.theorem: 20.10, with explicit constants proved in Theorem 21.3
new_result.coverage: The uniform phase law retains its stated signal, depth, noise, affine-price and confidence assumptions, including a separate gamma=0 proof. The fixed-depth bracket permits adaptive readouts at one fixed depth.

pdf_checks.visual_review: Revised first page inspected. The 300-word prose abstract and six keywords fit on the title page. The updated PDF has 74 pages and no unresolved reference markers.

scope: The phase resource law is for the stated calibrated binary phase model and remains a uniform comparison. The likelihood-lattice family has exact finite-confidence minimax costs for every positive readout price within the two declared readouts, including all adaptive and randomized policies in that catalogue. A separate proposition gives its exact qubit realizability region. General finite-outcome priced catalogues with pairwise-identifiable finite hypotheses are characterized by finite programs with a proved horizon error; computational efficiency is not claimed. These results do not optimize over all POVMs, unrestricted persistent-memory protocols or error-corrected implementations, and do not establish a general computational separation or novelty priority.

deep_extensions.fixed_depth_bracket: Theorem 21.2: cost between 1/12 and 9/4 times c(t)/s_t^2 [1 + log(1/delta)/G_t].
deep_extensions.global_bracket: Theorem 21.3: cost between 1/70 and 42 times the uniform scale; explicit attaining depth min(Dbar,ceil(r_eff/2)).
deep_extensions.readout_gain_scope: Interval-certified conclusive-readout gains over every fixed-Y policy, at stated very low noise; guaranteed price thresholds exceed 3.26, 4.89 and 6.52. These are mathematical stress cases, not attainable-hardware forecasts.
deep_extensions.calibration_band: Corollary 21.4: conditional parameter uncertainty with a strictly positive signal floor implies robust error and expected cost bounds.
deep_extensions.multihypothesis: Theorem 22.1 and Corollary 22.2: joint KL/affinity occupation LP and directly verified feasible dual; Proposition 22.3: recorded randomized-design ML upper bound. Six qutrit cases have certified lower and upper bounds.
deep_extensions.memory: Theorem 23.1: min of two directed measured divergences gives the adaptive block rate for arbitrary distinct full-rank states; regularization recovers min quantum divergence, while finite confidence requires entry cost at least (1-2delta)mc. Established rate theory is credited.
deep_extensions.stopping: Theorem 23.2: Bayesian finite-horizon truncation error at most lambda^2/(4*n*c_min), yielding a minimax lower certificate. Interpolation checks are floating point, not interval certification.

sharp_characterization.general_catalogue: Theorem 23.3: finite causal-policy LPs converge to exact minimax cost with an explicit O(1/N) bound. Corollary 23.4: uniform action separation improves this to exponential convergence.
sharp_characterization.binary_dual: Theorem 23.5: exact finite-confidence dual and exponential interval Bellman certificate for reflection-symmetric catalogues.
sharp_characterization.simulation: Lemma 23.6: conditional-law simulation at bounded expected cost gives catalogue dominance.
sharp_characterization.sharp_price: Theorem 23.7: explicit full-rank noncommuting qubits realize the sharp universal price threshold 6/5; no extra-readout benefit at or above it at any confidence, and strict benefit below it at sufficiently high confidence.
sharp_characterization.exact_frontier: Theorem 23.8: likelihood-lattice drift and parity give a matching converse attained by a mixture of at most two finite barriers, for all kappa>0 and 0<delta<1/2. Barriers need not be adjacent.
sharp_characterization.realizability: Proposition 23.9: necessary and sufficient qubit geometry and price-family parameter region, with an explicit POVM construction.
sharp_characterization.certificates: Nine exact rational optimal costs, including constructive policies, dual supporting lines and tail cutoffs; independent interval Bellman recursion at horizon 96 agrees within 1e-12. Table 4 intervals have width at most 1e-10 solely due to outward decimal display rounding.
sharp_characterization.interpretation: Exact cost claims are for the declared two-readout catalogue, not for all POVMs. Rational certificates are exact arithmetic, not a proof-assistant formalization.
